historical_policy: Keep historical failures verbatim. These current contracts provide separate qualification and do not change or silently reclassify the historical manifest.

cases.name: missing-docstring-strict
cases.reason: S1720 is inactive in the reference profile; strict findings must remain actionable through fix.

cases.name: dead-store-local
cases.reason: Reference subscribes to function definitions; positive qualification must use a function-local binding.

cases.name: dead-store-module-control
cases.reason: Historical positive fixture was outside the rule scope.

cases.name: dead-store-preserve-call
cases.source:
def f():
    x = 1
    print(x)
    x = work()

cases.name: identical-methods-minimum-body
cases.reason: The reference minimum implementation length is three source lines.

cases.name: identical-one-line-control
cases.reason: Historical positive fixture was below the source-backed body-length gate.

cases.name: django-model-field
cases.reason: Django model ancestry is required, not an arbitrary top-level API-looking call.

cases.name: django-top-level-control
cases.source:
from django.db import models
name = models.CharField(null=True)

cases.name: instance-empty-receiver
cases.reason: S2325 requires a valuable body; pass-only methods stay exempt.

cases.name: builtin-generic-exempt-import
cases.source:
from typing import List
x: List[int]
cases.reason: S1128 explicitly exempts typing imports; no newly unused-import warning is expected.
cases.projection:
from typing import List
x: list[int]

cases.name: identical-if-historical-refusal
cases.reason: Native preserves truth evaluation; upstream x=1 projection loses __bool__ effects. CLI must refuse the native projection because S2201 increases.

cases.name: identical-if-runtime-truth
cases.reason: Independent original/projected Python execution preserves truth effects and exceptions; refusal keeps original bytes.
cases.projection:
class Observed:
    def __bool__(self):
        print("truth effect"); return True
a = Observed()
bool((a))
x = 1
print(x)

cases.name: identical-if-runtime-false
cases.reason: Independent original/projected Python execution preserves truth effects and exceptions; refusal keeps original bytes.
cases.projection:
class Observed:
    def __bool__(self):
        print("false effect"); return False
a = Observed()
bool((a))
x = 1
print(x)

cases.name: identical-if-runtime-exception
cases.reason: Independent original/projected Python execution preserves truth effects and exceptions; refusal keeps original bytes.
cases.projection:
class Observed:
    def __bool__(self):
        print("exception effect"); raise ValueError("condition error")
a = Observed()
bool((a))
x = 1
print(x)
